model-value.desc: Model defining current panel name; use v-model

vertical.desc: Use vertical design (tabs stacked on top of each other)

align.desc: Horizontal alignment of tabs within the container

active-color.desc: Color for the text of the active tab

active-bg-color.desc: Color for the background of the active tab

indicator-color.desc: Color for the indicator (underline) of the active tab

narrow-indicator.desc: Indicator matches the tab content width instead of full tab width

inline-label.desc: Text is inline with the icon

no-caps.desc: Turns off capitalizing all letters within the tab

shrink.desc: Reverse default grow behavior; useful in QToolbar

stretch.desc: Tabs stretch to parent's height on flexbox parent

outside-arrows.desc: Reserve space for scroll arrows on each side

mobile-arrows.desc: Force display of arrows on mobile

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model
